name: EXP-C1 · Day 0 · Empty-room baseline (per zone)
description: Thirty minutes of empty hall per zone per band. This is what every later take is measured against.

config.description: The noise floor, the structural-variance fit and the trigger calibration all read this block. One warning from the probe: never calibrate the drift trigger on empty-room data alone — all four missed splice detections shared an empty-room-calibrated source.
Associate and pin before the baseline begins.
Thirty minutes, nobody inside the marked zone. Leave the phone in the zone, screen off, and stand outside it.
Repeat per zone and per band before any staged block runs.
